subject: Hosting choice: residency impact on legacy dataflows
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Sana Reddy <sana.reddy@novafin.com>, Novafin IT <it@novafin.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up: hosting options & EU/APAC residency constraints

Hi Sana — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before the technical deep dive.

Recap: 
- Primary constraint: customer PII and transaction logs for EU customers must remain in EU control plane and storage (GDPR / data residency).
- Secondary constraint: several legacy inbound connectors originate in APAC; some traffic currently transits through a Singapore edge before hitting EU services.
- Business ask: ability to use Hosted API if residency guarantees and KMS control are acceptable; otherwise Novafin will evaluate Dedicated pools or Private VPC.

What we promised to check / open items: 
1) Whether Hosted API can guarantee that request/response logs, KV caches, and audit trails for EU tenants are never persisted outside EU.
2) Cross-region routing behavior for burst traffic originating from APAC (will requests be routed to EU endpoints or allowed to hit APAC edge with synchronized KV?).
3) Key management: support for customer-managed CMEK (KMS) in EU and HSM-based key storage.
4) Data deletion SLA for transient inference caches vs long-term metrics.

Attachments: attached a quick residency checklist and your network diagram (residency-checklist.xlsx, novafin-network-diagram.png).

Proposed next steps / mutual action plan: 
- Redwoods: technical write-up on Hosted regional guarantees + Dedicated/private differences (deliver by Thu 12/3) — owner: Naomi.
- Novafin: provide a sanitized sample request flow and list of endpoints that must be kept in-EU (deliver by Wed 12/2) — owner: Sana.
- Schedule 90-min tech session with Karthik (serving/runtime) and Dylan (network/ops) to review cross-region routing and KV strategies — propose Wed 12/9 or Thu 12/10.

Can you confirm the two dates above or suggest alternatives? If Hosted is acceptable on the guarantees we outline, we can fast-track a PoC on dedicated EU-hosted capacity before talking Private VPC.

Thanks — Naomi
Naomi Feldman | Account Exec, Enterprise | Redwood Inference
Direct: +1 (415) 555-0192
From: Sana Reddy <sana.reddy@novafin.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Novafin IT <it@novafin.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 11:04:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Follow-up: hosting options & EU/APAC residency constraints

Hi Naomi — thanks for the summary, that's helpful. A couple quick clarifications before we schedule the deep dive so our infra team can prioritize: 

1) When you say "request/response logs" are kept in EU, does that include any third-party logging (e.g., error traces that might include stack frames, IPs)? We need to make sure nothing leaves the EU region — including backups and analytics exports.
2) For the APAC-origin traffic: is there a geo-failover where APAC bursts will temporarily serve from an APAC edge (with replicated KV) or will traffic always be routed to EU endpoints? If Hosted can do replicated KV with in-region persistence, that's preferable to sending PII out of region.
3) CMEK: we need confirmation on whether Redwood supports customer-managed keys in a EU KMS (we run a mix of Azure Key Vault and GCP KMS). We'd also like a note on FIPS/HSM compliance.

We've tentatively blocked Wed 12/9 10:00–11:30 CET for the tech session. I'll try to get a sanitized flow and a list of sensitive endpoints by Wed 12/2.

Sana
Sana Reddy | Head of Platform Security | Novafin
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Sana Reddy <sana.reddy@novafin.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Novafin IT <it@novafin.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 08:23:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: hosting options & EU/APAC residency constraints

Hi Sana — great questions. Short answers here and we'll expand in the technical write-up before the call.

1) Logs and backups: Hosted API can be configured such that all logs, metrics, and backups for your tenant are stored in our EU control plane (Frankfurt or Dublin) and not exported. We will include a matrix showing what is stored transiently vs persistently. Third-party troubleshooting traces are not shipped outside EU unless explicitly enabled by the customer.

2) APAC-origin traffic routing: two supported patterns —
   a) Strict routing: all inference traffic for the Novafin EU tenant terminates in EU endpoints (no APAC edge processing). This guarantees no PII leaves EU but may add latency for APAC-origin requests.
   b) Regional edge + KV replication: APAC edge can accept requests and use a replicated KV cache that persists only in EU at rest; we can configure synchronous replication for critical keys and async for lower-sensitivity caches. This option requires a Dedicated pool or Private VPC for stronger isolation and is subject to throughput constraints.

3) CMEK / HSM: We support customer-managed keys in both Azure and GCP KMS in EU regions for Dedicated and Private deployments today. Hosted API supports CMEK for audit logs and long-term storage on a per-account basis in select regions; we'll list exact coverage in the write-up and note FIPS/HSM posture.

Next: Karthik / Dylan — can you lead the tech session and prepare an appendix showing latency tradeoffs (EU termination vs APAC edge) and a short diagram of KV replication modes? I'll circulate the draft residency matrix by Thu 12/3.

Thanks — Naomi
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sana Reddy <sana.reddy@novafin.com>, Novafin IT <it@novafin.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: hosting options & EU/APAC residency constraints

Adding a short internal note and confirming we're on for Wed 12/9 10:00–11:30 CET. Agenda I'll prepare: 
- KV replication modes (sync vs async) and consistency guarantees
- Network path examples and expected RTTs for EU termination vs APAC edge
- CMEK integration steps and required Novafin IAM roles/permissions
- PoC checklist we can complete in 2 weeks if Hosted EU guarantees are acceptable

I'll prep the latency table and a candidate PoC plan (endpoint list, sample traces, success criteria). Dylan — can you map expected firewall/NAT changes from their provided network diagram?

-karthik
